title: Pocketwire Personal Account Funding Fees and Top-Up Rules
content:
### Fees

- **Credit card funding fee.** A Pocketwire Personal Account payment funded by a linked credit card carries a credit card funding fee equal to the payment amount times the plan's credit card funding fee rate, rounded to the cent (half up), charged as a separate fee entry on the payment date; the fee is charged to the balance and does not reduce the amount the recipient receives.
- **Instant top-up fee.** A customer-requested instant top-up from a linked debit card carries an instant top-up fee equal to the top-up amount times the plan's instant top-up fee rate, rounded to the cent (half up).
- **No funding fee.** Payments funded by the balance, a linked bank account or a linked debit card carry no funding fee, standard top-ups from a linked bank account are free, and the automatic funding pull behind a payment never carries its own top-up fee.

### Top-up limits

Customer-requested top-ups initiated on one calendar day — the day's earlier customer-requested top-ups, Eastern Time, plus the new top-up — may not exceed the plan's daily top-up limit, and no top-up may take the ledger balance above the plan's maximum ledger balance; a top-up that would breach either is declined in full. Automatic funding pulls behind a payment are not counted as customer-requested top-ups.

### Refund of a funding fee

A funding fee is refunded only when the underlying payment is refunded as an unclaimed invitation or reimbursed on an approved claim; a fee is never refunded because the customer chose a more expensive funding source.

### Fee by funding source

| Funding source of the payment or top-up | Fee |
|---|---|
| Linked credit card, for a payment | Credit card funding fee |
| Linked debit card, instant top-up requested by the customer | Instant top-up fee |
| Balance, linked bank account or linked debit card, for a payment | None |
| Linked bank account, standard top-up | None |
| Automatic funding pull behind a payment | No top-up fee of its own |

### Worked fees (hypothetical amounts and rates)

- A 200.00 payment funded by a credit card at a 3.00 percent rate carries a fee of 6.00; the recipient receives 200.00.
- A 333.33 payment at a 2.75 percent rate gives 9.166575, rounded half up to 9.17.
- A 150.00 instant top-up at a 1.25 percent rate carries a fee of 1.875, rounded half up to 1.88.
